content.short: Magik Moons Mythical 70’s band Weltschmerz recorded a seven-fold album. The unreleased album was lost .. until now!
content.description:
Magik Moons - The Lost Album The mythical German 70’s experimental band Weltschmerz aimed to push boundaries and had plans for releasing a seven-fold album. The unreleased album has been considered lost to the world....until now!

A trove of supposed drafts and proposals for the album cover art has recently been unearthed and will be released onto the blockchain.
